content: Henagaꞌamo hosu gemo aliꞌa apaya malesaya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo apava gemo huꞌniya gemae

Goti Aunemeꞌamoꞌmo huno ha leno hunoꞌaeꞌmo, henagaꞌamo mago vayaꞌmogi hosu apaune vayaꞌai gemo afige hosu enisole vayaꞌmogi aliꞌa apaya malesaya gemo afige huteꞌa siosi vayaꞌmogi apakesa afiꞌa fatago nehaya gemo ataleꞌa ugae, huno huꞌniye.
Apavayaletiꞌmo aigofe gemo hugayaꞌmonanafa apakupi mafaꞌnemo ago faliꞌnegekana huno maiꞌniye.

Apakaemo, aꞌmo oꞌalige veleꞌmo oꞌmaige neꞌyaꞌmo mosige hutapa maiyo, huꞌa aliꞌa apaya malegae. Gotiꞌa apakesa afiꞌa fatago huge lama geꞌamo afiꞌa aeto huge nehisaya vayaꞌmogimo neꞌyaꞌmo aliꞌneꞌa agaefekeꞌmo hao ke heteꞌa nesayafeꞌmo muki neꞌyaꞌamo alo hu maleꞌniye.
Muki alo huꞌniya yaꞌamo alagepa yaꞌageꞌmo haneꞌniyanageta lagaemo alita atalesuna yaꞌmo ohaneꞌnifa aliꞌnetaeꞌmo Gotifeꞌmo hao ke heteta alita nesuna yaꞌmo haneꞌniye.
Gotiꞌa afaꞌa negae, huno huꞌniyanageta nunumuꞌmo huteta afaꞌa alita negaune.
Timotifeꞌmo alagepa huka aliꞌyaꞌmo aliyo, huno ha paiꞌniya gemae

Kagaemo konagatimogifeꞌmo ani kavafeꞌmo alika apaya malesanaꞌmoꞌmo Yesu Kalaisi alagepa aliꞌya vekaꞌamo maigane. Lagesa afita fatago nehuna gemo alagepa huka akame huꞌnana gemo neꞌyaꞌmo alika negekana huka alika nesanagenoꞌaeꞌmo lokiya vaino kategaiye.

Kategaiyaꞌmonanafa ma mopafi gemo aote ohaneꞌniya gemo anekalo aꞌneꞌai kaitene gemo oꞌafika yokalo legefeꞌmo aeꞌa apakasesayafeꞌmo teleninimo nehaya kava huka Gotifeꞌmo alagepa huka mono hisanafeꞌmo teleninimo huvo.

Apakufaletiꞌmo teleninimo nehaya kavaꞌmoꞌmo aiseꞌamo hapa maegaiyaꞌmonanafa mono kavaꞌmoꞌa muki alagepa kavatefeꞌmo laha maegaiye. Gotiꞌa, alagepa mono nehaya kavaꞌmoꞌa afaꞌa maisaya kavatefeꞌmo hemeniꞌe afole aisiya afinaꞌeꞌmo lapa maegaiye, huno polomasi gemo huꞌniye.
Mani nehuna geeꞌmo lama gemo apakesa afiꞌa fatago huteꞌa alisaya gemo haneꞌniye.

Ani gelefeꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌmo neꞌalune. Gotiꞌa muki vayaꞌmo hapa neꞌmaeyaꞌmonanafa apakesa afiꞌa fatago nehaya vayaꞌai apakufamo alino katino apateno hapau neꞌvaiya vekaeꞌmo lavayagunagu huta agava neꞌmaunaꞌmofeꞌmo huꞌa faipa huꞌa nelatagetaeꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌamo neꞌalune.
Ani kavaꞌmo hiyo, huka huge alika apaya malege huka maiyo.

Kagaemo apakesa afiꞌa fatago nehaya vayaꞌmogi kakame hisayafeꞌmo alagepa gemo huge alagepa kavaꞌmo huge kahau kayamopafiꞌmo kahauge kayamukiki huge alagepa huka kagesa afika fatago huge yaveyave kavaꞌmo huge huka maigeꞌapao afa neya vekamo maiꞌniye, huꞌa osiyo.
Kagaemo Goti geꞌamo alagepa huꞌa lekana paige ani kavaꞌmo hiyo, huꞌa aeꞌa hakalo huꞌa hapa paige aliꞌa apaya malege hisayafeꞌmo yagaika apateme apateme neꞌugeꞌna eno.

Yagaiꞌa neꞌapataya vayatama vayaꞌmogi kagaeteꞌmo apayaꞌmo maleꞌa kateteꞌa Gotitegatiꞌmo aliꞌnaya geletiꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌamo alisanafeꞌmo lokiyaꞌamo aliꞌa kamiꞌnae. Fiku yanageno kamiꞌnaya yaꞌmo afaꞌa hanegaiyanagi kamiꞌnaya yatetiꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌmo aliyo.
Ani kavatefeꞌmo kagesa afifi huka maiꞌnekaeꞌmo lokiya vaika aliꞌyaꞌmo aligeꞌapao alagepa kavakamoꞌmo kosime kosime neꞌviya kavakamo mukiꞌamogimo ageyo.

Kagaikaleꞌmo alagepa huka yagaiꞌneka alika apaya neꞌmalana kavateꞌmo yagaika maiyo. Yagaime yagaime uka maiyo kagaika kagufamo alika katika kateteka gekamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌai apakufamo alika katika apategananagi.
